title: FactoryProfile
description: The project profile's fields. The profile on disk is Markdown with `## <field>` sections, so this schema describes the FIELDS: each one a non-empty string, because a section with an empty body is a fact the agent would have to invent. `concurrency` is the only optional field -- it defaults to 3 and is hard-capped at 5.

base_branch.description: Branch every job branches from and hands off to.

setup_command.description: Command that prepares a fresh checkout (install dependencies, generate types).

fast_gate.description: Verification command run on every build round. Must not require a build step.

full_gate.description: Verification command run once before handoff. Must match CI exactly.

high_risk_areas.description: Paths or subsystems that force the `approval` tier and always escalate.

protected_paths.description: One repository-relative glob per Markdown bullet, or `none`. A change touching one stops for a human on every tier before verification.

review_perspectives.description: Which reviewers apply to this project, and any project-specific checklist.

non_goals.description: Explicitly out-of-scope work that must not be introduced.

known_limitations.description: Things this project's checks do not cover. Disclose; never paper over.

concurrency.description: Jobs `/factory dispatch` runs in parallel when given no argument. Optional; defaults to 3. Hard-capped at 5. One value applies to the whole project.
